summary: Operational procedure for migrating one Product from the predecessor through the delivered importer: a per-Product harvest of the sanctioned read surface with pinned derivation rules, a preflight inventory that enumerates the CD-0097 mode surfaces with included/excluded classification, counts, and capture gaps, a rehearsed import with declared Product identity, full project set, and deliberately selected active work, idempotent replay with typed no-op reports, harvest-drift tolerance for changes the predecessor moved to a terminal state or out of the active set, typed refusal for surfaces outside the mode and for Concord-side changes to predecessor-owned items naming the owning source, followed by predecessor freeze for that Product (a Product under CD-0097's bounded parallel mode is exempt and keeps the predecessor live until cutover), fix-forward, wisdom curation through the formalization procedure, and validated snapshots as the historical record. Guidance for a correct operation under CD-0082, not a mandated gate.
title: Predecessor migration runbook
